spec.name: implementer-return-fixture
spec.intent: Census @7a2306b7 (the unit's own landing; design and notebook as at 8742a725); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number, count or observed behaviour cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Add no new test file. Run one test file inside its package with `pnpm exec vitest run <file>`. Realize the implementer role in the corpus's one worked example of a dispatch to it and its return: the implementer builds one unit from its spec alone, never the design; it returns only the unit's name, `landed <unit> of <plan> at <commit>` or `blocked <unit> of <plan>: spec`, never an account; the assayer judges the unit against its shard from the files at that commit; a verdict of not achieved comes back to the same implementer with the assayer's findings; and it builds in its own isolated worktree off the plan's line, never on main (packages/canon/src/dimensions/role/implementer.ts). The pair packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/delegation-prompt.md and subagent-return.md (pinned by packages/canon/test/reader-reach.test.ts:42-48 as classes delegation-prompt and subagent-return; :96-102 requires the dispatch to show no human-register signal) contradicts it. AT 7a2306b7 the dispatch opens '# dispatch: add-endpoint — plan healthz, wave(0), agent: implementer', builds 'off main', names 'plan lead' as the judge, decides acceptance 'from the return alone' and requires a return of files, evidence, gates and deviations; the return, relabelled by the first landing to come from a 'contractor', still carries that account, so a dispatch to the implementer is answered by another agent (note 'delegation-prompt fixture still dispatches to the implementer under the old return contract'). CHANGE. Rewrite the pair as one dispatch to this corpus's implementer and its return under the role: the dispatch gives the unit's address (`add-endpoint of healthz`) and says to build it; it carries no inlined spec (the implementer reads it with `cratylus plan show <unit> --plan <plan>`), no branch off main, no judge other than the assayer, no acceptance decided from the return, and no return shape beyond the name; the return is the name alone, `landed add-endpoint of healthz at <a commit id>`, with the header naming the implementer. Both stay dense and still conform as their classes. Update the reader-reach.test.ts header comment where it says the fixtures were produced on consumer projects on 2026-07-01, so it says what this pair now depicts; change no assertion there. No changeset (test fixtures and a test comment alone change).
accept: `grep -c -E 'off .main|plan lead|from the return alone|## files|## evidence|## gates|## deviations|contractor' packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/delegation-prompt.md packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/subagent-return.md` prints 0 for each file; at 7a2306b7 it prints a non-zero count for each

`grep -c 'agent: implementer' packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/delegation-prompt.md packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/subagent-return.md` prints 1 for each, and `grep -c -E '^landed add-endpoint of healthz at [0-9a-f]{7,40}$' packages/canon/test/fixtures/generated/subagent-return.md` prints 1; at 7a2306b7 the return prints 0 for both
